Grafted Colloid
===============

.. autofunction:: snap_simulate.system.molecules.make_grafted_colloid

YAML Configuration Example
--------------------------

.. code-block:: yaml

   molecule_type: "grafted_colloid"
   colloid_type: 0
   arm_beads: 5
   num_arms: 12
   arm_type: 1
   end_type: 2
   bond_type: 0
   num_molecules: 5
